title: Set up your school's people
headline: Set up your *school's people*
sub: Schools on, a bursar and a gateman invited with the right roles.

recap.en: Bright Hill Academy has a proprietor, a bursar and a gate.
recap.pcm: Bright Hill Academy get proprietor, bursar and gate.

bridge.en: The school's people are in. Where are the classes and terms?
bridge.pcm: School people don enter. Where the classes and terms dey?

flow.purpose: she owns the school and Schools is on
flow.action: Sits at her desk, slides her glasses down, reads her phone, then gives a slow nod and a small smile
flow.setting: the proprietor's office at Bright Hill Academy: a bookshelf, a framed school crest, a term planner on a dark desk, soft morning light
flow.camera: medium shot, slow push-in, soft morning light

flow.action: Unlocks the green iron gate and swings it open to an empty yard, then looks up at the classrooms with a gentle smile
flow.setting: the green iron gate of Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu: a cream two-storey classroom block with a pine-green stripe, a red-earth yard, a flame tree, a gatehouse with a folding stool
flow.camera: wide to medium shot, eye-level, early light

en: Schools is on at Bright Hill Academy.
In School, she opens School settings.
Schools is on: students, fees, the gate.
Large cash waits for a second person.
Mr Ibe is the bursar: name, number, role.
The role is Bursar, added when Schools is turned on.
Mallam Audu, the gateman, gets the Gate role.
Both wait until they say yes.
Audu's phone opens on the gate screen only.
pcm: Schools don dey on for Bright Hill Academy.
For School, she open School settings.
Schools dey on: students, fees, the gate.
Big cash go wait for second person.
Mr Ibe na bursar: name, number, role.
The role na Bursar. Dem add am when Schools dey on.
Dem go invite am for WhatsApp.
Mallam Audu, the gateman, get Gate role.
Dem both go wait until dem talk yes.
Audu phone go open for gate screen only.
